name: @sichos-kodesh/archive
description: The canonical archive of the Rebbe's Torah media: every upstream file (JEM audio, Drive hanachos) fetched once, stored by SHA-256 with provenance in a versioned SQLite store, verified on a schedule. The source everything downstream (packs, the download site, the Drive, the apps) builds from.

scripts.prebuild: npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/pack-format && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/igros-index && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/sefaria-index
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/pack-format && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/mafteiach-index && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/igros-index && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/sefaria-index
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/pack-format && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/mafteiach-index && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/igros-index && npm run build -w @sichos-kodesh/sefaria-index
